#!/usr/bin/perl
# Perl の見本
use strict;
use warnings;
use List::Util qw(sum max);

our $VERSION = '1.02';
my %map = (key => 'value', 'other' => "x $VERSION");
my @items = (1 .. 10);
my $ref = { list => [@items], code => sub { return $_[0] * 2 } };

sub greet {
    my ($name, %opts) = @_;
    $name //= 'world';
    return sprintf("Hello, %s! %d\n", $name, $opts{count} // 0);
}

for my $i (grep { $_ % 2 == 0 } @items) {
    next if $i > 8;
    print "even: $i\n";
}

while (my $line = <STDIN>) {
    chomp $line;
    if ($line =~ m{^(\w+)\s*=\s*(.*)$}x) {
        $map{$1} = $2;
    } elsif ($line =~ s/foo/bar/g) {
        print STDERR "replaced\n";
    }
    (my $copy = $line) =~ tr/a-z/A-Z/;
}

my $text = <<"END";
heredoc $VERSION @{[ sum(@items) ]}
END
my $raw = q{single 'quoted'} . qq{double "quoted" $VERSION};
my @words = qw(alpha beta gamma);
open(my $fh, '<', 'file.txt') or die "cannot open: $!";
local $/ = undef;
printf "%s %d\n", $ref->{list}[0], max(@items) unless 0;
__END__
=pod

POD の本文

=cut
